reference_diagnostics: Both replays pass fanout, ratsnest, placement contracts and placement flow; hard_red=0 and no nonsearch fallback events.
limits: No newly qualified board or timing speedup claimed. Rotation-enabled 163x152 not rerun after its preceding expensive failure; this change's only new smaller-outline screen is 162x153. Diagnostic timings are single uncontrolled runs, not historical Python comparisons.
